findings.impact: Instantiation raises `TypeError: Can't instantiate abstract class MetricAlertDetectorHandler` because `StatefulDetectorHandler` declares abstract methods (`counter_names`, `get_dedupe_value`, `get_group_key_values`, and the newly added `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) that this subclass leaves unimplemented.
findings.root_cause: Changing the base class to the abstract `StatefulDetectorHandler` (which now also requires `build_occurrence_and_event_data`) without providing concrete implementations in the subclass.

findings.verifier_reason: Patch lines R11-R12 show MetricAlertDetectorHandler inherits from StatefulDetectorHandler with only 'pass'. Context confirms StatefulDetectorHandler has abstract methods counter_names, get_dedupe_value, get_group_key_values, and build_occurrence_and_event_data. Line 27 shows detector_handler = MetricAlertDetectorHandler, and detector.py:86 shows instantiation via group_type.detector_handler(self). This will raise TypeError at runtime.

pr.body:
This adds a hook that can be implemented to produce an occurrence specific to the detector that is subclassing the StatefulDetector.

Also change the signature of evaluate to return a dict keyed by groupkey instead of a list. This helps avoid the chance of duplicate results for the same group key.
